parallel: After the first step, a setup's steps run in any order: products, tills, payments, fiscal and staff. The checklist is one list with a changing sub-line per item, not a wizard that blocks
Presence and a call run beside the record; neither changes what the record shows
A fiscal device check can take minutes; setup carries on while it is Checking with ZIMRA
An import runs while the person carries on; the result lands as a notification and on the list
cut: No 'accept the terms' step for an invited person; joining is acceptance
No password at signup or on accepting; an emailed or texted code
No asking a Tender owner what they sell when they import a file: the file says it
No team-size question at signup: inviting answers it
No tour. Empty states and the checklist do the teaching
No 'confirm role' screen after an invite: the role is on the invite and can be changed later

source (till, phone, computer, WhatsApp, email, import, ZIMRA, the bank)

work moving: quote or invoice sent, opened, approved, declined
field changes: one or more fields changed, with before and after

views.timeline: one record, newest first. Person-written events one per line, never rolled up. Work-moving events one per line. One person's field changes within an hour roll into 'Rudo changed value and close date', opening in place. Machine events of one kind on one day roll into a line with a count and a total. Filters: Everything, Comments, Documents, Calls, Changes
views.history: one record, every field change with before, after, who, when and source. Its own tab
views.activity: the whole workspace, for people with the permission, by day then by record. Filters by person, module and record type
views.notifications: one member's: Needs you first, then the rest by day. Several events on one record within an hour group under the record with a count. Mentions are never grouped

fan_out.Needs you: mention, assigned, handed over, approval asked, follow-up due, seat request, ownership offer, a call on a record you are on
fan_out.For your information: a record you own, are on or follow changed: stage, document sent or answered, payment, a comment. Never field edits
fan_out.never: your own actions; Vane's suggestions (they live on For you)

events.channels: in-app always. Email and WhatsApp by the member's settings per kind (NotificationSetting). Needs you defaults to in-app and WhatsApp; the rest to in-app only. Quiet hours 20:00 to 06:00 hold WhatsApp and phone
events.schema: Three stores today: PlatformAuditEvent (one event per request: activity), CrmActivity with CrmComment, CrmRecordFile and field history (the timeline), Notification with NotificationRecipient. Keep the stores. Give the timeline one reader that merges them by subjectType and subjectId. Add needsAction to Notification so Needs you is a query; actedAt already exists. Extend subject keys to retail customers, products and suppliers.

live.transport: LiveKit, one room per record ('record:<type>:<id>') joined while the record page is open and visible; left after 60 seconds hidden
carries: calls: audio, then video or screen share when asked
never_carries: anything that must be kept: comments and edits go to the API and Postgres first, then the room is told to refresh
live.tokens: minted by our server only for members who can see the record; a token names one room and lasts 1 hour
live.presence_rules: Here = page open and visible. Away = hidden or idle 5 minutes; dimmed, then gone after 10 minutes
live.region: LiveKit Cloud Africa group: one location in South Africa, no in-region redundancy; falls back to EU. Voice crossing the border is checked against the Cyber and Data Protection Act before launch; self-hosting is the alternative
live.fallback: /api/live (SSE) keeps notification counts. With LiveKit down, records work fully; only presence and calls are missing, and the page says so
